$comment: AI visual review (pnpm a11y:visual) — advisory: a person confirms findings and records the review with pnpm a11y:review.

answers.reason: Selected state uses shape difference (filled vs empty circle), not color alone. Invalid state indicated by both red outline and red text message.
Radio button circles and focus rings have clear contrast in light and dark modes. Focus indicators are prominent and distinguishable.
All visible text matches screen reader announcements: 'Free Up to 3 editors, unlimited viewers' matches, 'Pro' matches, etc. across all stories including error text and alert.
No text truncation or overlapping observed in any screenshot.
Default: Pro has large blue focus circle. Horizontal: Just me has large blue focus circle. Invalid: Free has large blue focus circle. All are obvious and prominent.
